overview: Finalize the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-based physics solver for zero-allocation stability, and compressing the storyteller event log into a bit-packed format to reduce memory footprint during long-running sessions.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Hashing
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::span<const uint8_t> for input. Implement FNV-1a 64-bit hash using constexpr loops. No dynamic allocation. Return uint64_t. Handle endianness explicitly via std::endian::native check. Ensure stable ordering for struct members.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Hash value is identical across x86_64 and ARM64 for same input. 0 heap allocations during hash computation. <10ns per 64-byte block.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load verification, preventing corrupted state errors in long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick Solver with Fixed-Point Arithmetic
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace float with int64_t fixed-point (scale 1000). Implement iterative Gauss-Seidel solver for constraint resolution. Max 4 iterations. Use std::array for contact manifolds. No virtual calls in hot loop.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Deterministic results across all platforms. No NaN propagation. 1000 entities solved in <0.5ms on i7-12700.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Stable physics behavior in large colonies, eliminating 'jitter' in stacked objects.

tasks.title: Bit-Packed Event Log Compression
tasks.architectural_spec: Define enum class EventType : uint8_t. Pack timestamp (uint32_t) and type (uint8_t) into uint64_t. Use std::vector<uint64_t> for storage. Implement decode function using bitwise shifts. No string storage in hot path.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Memory usage reduced by 60% compared to struct-based log. Decode speed >10M events/sec.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster UI rendering for event history, smoother scrolling in long games.
